Server components execute on server and can fetch server-side data; client components use interactive
state/effects/browser APIs with 'use client' boundary. Never expose secrets to client.
Server component එක server එJක් data ගන්න පුළුවන්. Client component එක state, effects සහ
browser interaction වලෙට Jයාදොගන්නවා. Secrets server එJක්ම තියාගන්න.

Read the diagram: A server page can compose an interactive client component; boundary props must be serializable
as required.
Expected result: A click updates the client counter; server-only secrets are not passed to it.

Interview question: Does 'use client' mean no server HTML?
Answer: No. Client components may be pre-rendered and then hydrated.
